'''2012 Canadian Nationals Alex O'Shea LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
